title: Class 11 human review response
description: One response per artifact. Unit results are required and must not be collapsed to the artifact verdict: an artifact may be REVISE while three of its four units are ALIGNED.

reviewer.description: Reviewer name or approved reviewer code. A response without this is not a human review.

reviewedFingerprint.description: Copy from the packet. Binds this review to the exact instructional content read. If the lesson's content changes, the fingerprint changes and the review no longer applies.

unitResults.description: One entry per canonical unit the artifact claims to cover. All must be answered.

materialAlignment.description: Does the lesson MATERIALLY TEACH this objective — instructed, not merely mentioned?

crowdedOut.description: For multi-unit artifacts: was this objective squeezed by the others?

lessonGranularity.description: The architectural question. A SHOULD_SPLIT here matters beyond this lesson — it bears on whether Class 12 should inherit the same unit-to-lesson mapping.

severity.description: CRITICAL: instruction is unsafe or materially wrong. MAJOR: a required objective is missing, a serious conceptual problem, or wrong granularity. Typography alone is MINOR unless it changes mathematical meaning.
